title: Jab piyo paani
body:
Husain Husain (4)
Mazloom Husain beykas Husain
Pyaasey Husain aaqa Husain
Shiyati Maa in sharibtum ma'a azbin fazkurooni (2)
Aw samiyatum Bey gareebin aw shaheedin fandobuni
Daaman e sabr o wilaa dast e wilaa mey thaamlo
Parcham e abbas key saaye mey Har in'aam lo
Tishnagaan e karbalaa pey zindagi ka jaam lo
<<MINI>>
Jab piyo paani Husain Ibne ali ka naam lo (2)
Ya Husain Ibne ali (4)
<<DIVIDER>>
1) tum azadar e Hussaini sogwaar e Karbala
Maut Bhi kya cheez Jo rokey tumhaara raasta
Dhoop mey haasil hai saaya parcham e abbas ka
Haath maatam ko uthaawo aur wafa se kaam lo
<<MINI>>
Jab piyo paani Husain Ibne ali ka naam lo (2)
Ya Husain Ibne ali (4)
<<DIVIDER>>
2) Yaad rakhna WO tabassum asgar e beysheer ka
Hausla todaa hai jisney hurmala key teer ka
Bey zabaani mey tha jiski maujza taqdeer ka
Aao us bachey se ab tarbiyyat e islaam lo
<<MINI>>
Jab piyo paani Husain Ibne ali ka naam lo (2)
Ya Husain Ibne ali (4)
<<DIVIDER>>
3) chaadar e zainab bayaa kartey raho taqdeer mey
Zulm ki gardan ko rakhkho zikr ki zanjeer mey
Inteqaam e Karbala ho seena e shamsheer mey
Ashq e ghum ki nazr deykar quld ka in'aam lo
<<MINI>>
Jab piyo paani Husain Ibne ali ka naam lo (2)
Ya Husain Ibne ali (4)
<<DIVIDER>>
4) zulm ney sab kuch kiyaa lekin huwa kuch Bhi nahi
Zindagi zauq e shahaadat ke siwaa kuch Bhi nahi
Deen Jo Bhi naa siwaaye Karbala kuch Bhi nahi
Karbala waalo sey jeeney ka sabaq Har gaam lo
<<MINI>>
Jab piyo paani Husain Ibne ali ka naam lo (2)
Ya Husain Ibne ali (4)
<<DIVIDER>>
5) nusrat e dee'n key liye kaisey nikalnaa chaahiye
Raahey deen e mustafa pey kaisey chalna chaahiye
Kis tarha taqdeer e aalam ko badalna chaahiye
Karbala se hazrat e Shabbir ka paigaam lo
<<MINI>>
Jab piyo paani Husain Ibne ali ka naam lo (2)
Ya Husain Ibne ali (4)
<<DIVIDER>>
6) inteqaam e Karbala ki hai sadaaye Al hazar
Goonj se jiskey jahaa mey hil rahey hai baam o darr
Muntazar ko dhoondti hai Har mujaahid ki nazar
Ab imam e waqt ko aawaaz do anjaam lo
<<MINI>>
Jab piyo paani Husain Ibne ali ka naam lo (2)
Ya Husain Ibne ali (4)
<<DIVIDER>>
7) Karbala hai kushta e Shabbir hai aur hum abad
Zindagi badhtey rahey kartey raho maatam abad
Qaas neymat hai ataa e sayyada ye hum abad
Baargaah e sayyada se khuld ka in'aam lo
<<MINI>>
Jab piyo paani Husain Ibne ali ka naam lo (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Husain Husain (2)
